title: identities.json identities
description: The identities at identity providers linked to the person, also unlinked ones. No tokens of the provider are stored or exported.

subject.description: Subject of the person at the provider.

issuer.description: Issuer the provider reported; absent when none was stored.

email_at_link.description: E-mail address the provider reported when the identity was linked; absent when none.

last_login_at.description: Last login with this identity; absent when never used.

unlinked_at.description: When the identity was unlinked; absent while it is linked.
